title: Slow English Podcast #365: 20 Easy Facts About Bhutan

sentences.text: Hello everyone, my name is Emily. Welcome to the Slow English Podcast. I'm very happy
you are here today. Today we will learn about a beautiful country in South Asia. The country
is Bhutan. I will speak slowly and use easy English. Let's begin.
Fact 1. Bhutan is in South Asia. Bhutan is a small country in South Asia. It is
between India and China. The country is in the Himalaya mountains. Bhutan is famous
for its nature, mountains and peaceful life. Many people visit Bhutan every year.
Fact 2. The capital city is Thimphu. Thimphu is the capital of Bhutan. It is the
largest city in the country. Many people live and work there. The city has temples,
markets and beautiful views. Thimphu is a peaceful capital city. Fact 3. Bhutan has
beautiful mountains. The Himalaya mountains cover much of Bhutan. Many mountains are very high. People
enjoy hiking and exploring nature. The mountains are important for the country's culture. The views are
amazing. Fact 4. The official language is Zonka. Zonka is the national language of Bhutan.
Many other local languages are also spoken. Children learn Zonka at school. English is also
used in education. Bhutan has a rich language culture. Fact 5. Bhutan is known for gross
national happiness. Bhutan measures happiness as an important part of life. The country believes
that people's well-being is important. Nature, culture and community are valued. Many people
know Bhutan for this special idea. Happiness is part of Bhutanese culture. Fact 6. Buddhism
is important in Bhutan. Buddhism is the main religion of Bhutan. Many temples and monasteries
exist. People visit these places for prayer and peace. Buddhist traditions are part of daily life.
Religion and culture are connected. Fact 7. Bhutan has beautiful forests. Many forests
cover the country. The forests protect plants and animals. People respect nature. Many areas are
protected. Bhutan is one of the countries with rich natural beauty. Fact 8. Family is very important.
Families spend time together. People respect parents and grandparents. Family traditions are strong.
People help each other. Community life is important. Fact 9. Bhutan has traditional clothes.
Many people wear traditional clothes. Men often wear the go. Women often wear the kira.
These clothes are worn during special events. Traditional clothing shows Bhutanese culture.
Fact 10. Bhutan has unique buildings. Bhutan has beautiful traditional buildings.
Many buildings have colorful designs. Temples and monasteries are very special.
Architecture shows the country's history. Visitors enjoy seeing these places.
Fact 11. Bhutan has rare animals. Many special animals live in Bhutan.
The Taiki is the national animal. Snow leopards and red pandas also live there.
Nature protection is very important. Wildlife is respected. Fact 12. Bhutan has four seasons.
Spring brings flowers and green forests. Summer is warm and rainy. Autumn has clear skies.
Winter is cold in the mountains. Each season has its own beauty.
Fact 13. Farming is important. Many people work in agriculture. They grow rice, vegetables,
and fruits. Farmers use traditional methods. Farming supports many families.
Nature is important for farming. Fact 14. Bhutan has colorful festivals.
Festivals are called shatu. People wear traditional clothes. They watch dances and music performances.
Families and communities come together. Festivals are full of color and joy.
Fact 15. Archery is the national sport. Archery is very popular in Bhutan. People play it during festivals.
Teams compete in villages and cities. It is an important tradition.
Sports bring people together. Fact 16. Bhutan protects nature.
The country cares about the environment. Many forests and animals are protected.
People try to live in harmony with nature. Clean air and beautiful landscapes are important.
Nature is a treasure. Fact 17. The people are friendly. Visitors often say Bhutanese people are kind
and welcoming. People respect guests. Hospitality is important. Travelers enjoy meeting local people.
Many visitors remember Bhutan warmly. Fact 18. Tourism is carefully managed.
Bhutan welcomes visitors from around the world. The country protects its culture and nature.
People visit temples, mountains and villages. Tourism focuses on quality experiences.
Bhutan offers peaceful travel. Fact 19. Bhutan has delicious food. Rice is a common food.
Chili and cheese are used in many dishes.
Imadachi is a famous Bhutanese meal. People enjoy traditional cooking. Food is part of the culture.
Fact 20. Bhutan is a country full of nature, culture and happiness. It has beautiful mountains,
peaceful monasteries, green forests, unique traditions and friendly people.
Visitors can enjoy nature, history and local culture.
Bhutan may be small, but it offers unforgettable experiences.
episode. Goodbye.
